relations: Incoming wave crests advance shoreward, then collapse into foam that spreads across the wet sand.
As water recedes, the thin film on the sand continues mirroring the orange and blue sky.
Foam edges thin and dissolve while the next wave line begins to rise farther out.
Cloud shapes drift slowly, and their reflected colors shift correspondingly on the glossy beach surface.
